states.meaning: Cheerful 4-second toy dance: three alternating side-to-side beats with small whole-body hops, coordinated arm swings, gentle head tilts; the shoulder dragon stays perched/attached; ends in the starting pose.

requirements.description: Perform three clearly readable alternating side-to-side beats over the clip duration (left-right-left or right-left-right), with timing that reads as an intentional rhythm.
Add small whole-body hops synchronized with the beat: visible upward-and-downward body motion (toy-like, modest amplitude) while also shifting side-to-side.
Swing both arms in coordination with the side-to-side beats (arms move visibly and symmetrically/alternating in a toy-dance style; no new props).
Gently tilt the head in coordination with the beat (small, readable tilts; maintain a friendly toy demeanor).
Keep the dragon perched and attached to the panda shoulder throughout: the dragon follows the shoulder/body motion without separating, flying, or drifting away.
Finish in the same overall starting pose: panda body position/orientation returns to its initial placement at the end of the clip.
Finish with arms returning to their starting pose (no held-out final gesture).
Finish with head returning to its starting pose (neutral at clip end).

roles.description: Main panda body/root including torso, hips/legs and overall translation used for sways and small hops.
Both panda arms/forearms/paws used for coordinated swinging.
Panda head/neck used for gentle tilts (no facial expression requirements).
Green shoulder dragon companion attached on the panda shoulder; must remain perched and follow along.

states.user_request: A cheerful four-second toy dance with three alternating side-to-side beats, small whole-body hops, coordinated arm swings and gentle head tilts. Keep the shoulder dragon perched. Finish in the starting pose. This is authored toy motion, not physical balance or contact simulation.
